a.label: UAP Gerb - Northrop Grumman & TRW investigation (Vol.2)

edges.label: Built on Grusch's statements about Clapper and O'Sullivan
edges.note: Gerb extrapolates from Grusch's remarks on Megyn Kelly and from Grusch's statement that James Clapper and Stephanie O'Sullivan managed the crash retrieval issue at ODNI.

a.label: UAP Gerb - Northrop Grumman & TRW investigation (Vol.2)

edges.label: Alleges IRAD self-funding of a breakaway programme after 9/11
edges.note: The specific financial allegation: that Northrop used Independent Research and Development funds at the onset of the War on Terror to self-fund retrieval and exploitation, becoming unaccountable to its original government handler. IRAD is contractor-directed and only indirectly reimbursed, which makes it the mechanism that would allow exactly this.

a.label: UAP Gerb - Northrop Grumman & TRW investigation (Vol.2)

edges.label: Traces Stephanie O'Sullivan from TRW to ODNI to the Aerospace board
edges.note: O'Sullivan is a former TRW engineer, former Principal Deputy Director of National Intelligence and a current Aerospace Corporation board member - a single career spanning prime contractor, IC leadership and FFRDC governance.

a.label: UAP Gerb - The MITRE Corporation investigation

edges.label: Groups Aerospace Corporation with MITRE as the FFRDC layer
edges.note: Gerb's FFRDC thesis treats MITRE and the Aerospace Corporation as parallel instances of the same mechanism; the Aerospace link is reinforced by Stephanie O'Sullivan's board membership there after ODNI. The specific allegation against Aerospace is inference from the model rather than a separately documented claim.
